title: Earth's average density
description: Essential: The final expression for ρ must be correct and derived from equating surface gravity to gravitational force.

title: Satellite altitude expression
description: Essential: The final expression for h must be correct, derived from equating gravitational force to centripetal force.

title: Apply surface gravity relation
description: Important: Must equate mg to GMm/R² to relate g, G, M, and R.

title: Apply satellite force balance
description: Important: Must equate gravitational force GMm₁/(R+h)² to centripetal force m₁(2π/T)²(R+h).

title: Substitute mass correctly
description: Important: Must correctly substitute M = ρ(4/3)πR³ into the density derivation and M = gR²/G into the altitude derivation.

title: Algebraic manipulation
description: Optional: Shows clear, logical steps in solving for ρ and h without algebraic errors.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Mentions or checks that the final expressions have correct units for density and distance.

title: Incorrect centripetal force
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect formula for centripetal force (e.g., wrong angular speed or radius).

title: Sign or radius confusion
description: Pitfall: Confuses R, R+h, or altitude h with orbital radius, leading to an incorrect final expression.
